Hello, I’m Eric! Welcome to my personal website for EPPS 6356 Data Visualization.


I am a Master’s student in the Social Data Analytics and Research program at the University of Texas at Dallas.



This website will serve as a repository for my coursework, assignments, and projects throughout the Fall 2026 semester.
